task.title: Filter corpus samples by attempt diagnostic presence
task.objective: Select records by whether any attempt carries a non-null diagnostic while preserving optional-field semantics
acceptance_criteria: True matches when any attempt diagnostic is non-null
False matches when every diagnostic is null, including records without attempts
An empty string remains structurally present
Diagnostic text and attempt outcomes do not affect matching

attempts.summary: Added regressions for no attempts, null, present, empty-string, composition, parser failure, and invalid corpus behavior
attempts.diagnostic: The CLI rejected the unknown has-attempt-diagnostic option

attempts.summary: Added existential optional-field matching without text normalization or outcome inference
Added a mixed null and present attempt case identified during independent review
attempts.diagnostic: The initial coverage did not directly prove existential matching across mixed attempts

attempts.summary: Added explicit-null and omitted-diagnostic false cases after actionable pull-request review
attempts.diagnostic: Review found that absent diagnostics were not directly covered in both accepted JSON shapes

outcome.summary: Sampling can select records by exact attempt-diagnostic optional-field presence

lessons: Optional-field presence is distinct from non-empty text
Mixed-entry tests are necessary to prove existential predicates rather than first-entry matching
